_comment: Rules for tools/review-lint.py. These are EXAMPLES from one GameCube project (doldecomp/sms) -- replace them with your own project's review history. Fields: id, pattern (Python regex), message, fix, source, advisory (optional, default false), skip (optional list of path substrings). skip_paths lists files where no rule fires -- typically the files defining the accessors the rules recommend.

fix: use SMSGetMSound()->... -- all sounds go through the accessor. (The method is separate: prefer the startSoundActor wrapper over an open-coded gateCheck + MSoundSESystem call.)
source: project-wide commit 557d2ef 'All sounds go through SMSGetMSound()'

fix: use the MTX* wrapper macro instead -- MTXConcat, MTXMultVec, etc.
source: maintainer cleanup commit ee4f0f7; repeated on a later review

fix: use checkLiveFlag(LIVE_FLAG_...) / checkLiveFlag2(...)
source: PR review; LiveActor.hpp already provides the accessor

fix: look for a getter before reading unkNN -- e.g. MActor/J3DModel accessors instead of mMActor->unk4->unk20
source: maintainer cleanup: 'always look for a getter before reading unkNN'

fix: name the states -- enum { STATE_REVOLVING = 2 }; case STATE_REVOLVING:
source: maintainer cleanup: named enums for state machines

message: reaches a field by casting to a byte pointer and adding a literal offset
fix: name the field in the class's header and reach it normally. A raw offset can match 100% and still be wrong -- it encodes a layout guess the compiler cannot check. If the field's purpose is unknown, read its uses (loader, resize, draw) and name it from those; leaving the function unmatched beats shipping a cast.
source: a review that called two of these 'fake matching'. Raw offsets are one of the few fabrication signals a machine can check, which is why this is a rule and not a review comment somebody has to make by hand

message: a frame-padding diagnostic scaffold is still in the source
fix: delete it before opening a PR. `char trash[0x40];` is a legitimate way to cancel a frame delta so objdiff shows only the real code differences -- but it is a measuring device, not source. Shipping one is fabricated padding, which this project rejects outright.
source: maintainer guidance 2026-08-27: the trash trick can be used to isolate small mismatches, but it has to be removed before a PR is made

message: leaves a working note in the code
fix: delete it. Agent PRs carry no comments except `// fabricated`; match state, frame sizes and TODOs go out of date and objdiff already shows them. The maintainer's one exception: an UNUSED function forced inline as a hack gets a TODO saying so (suppress this rule on that line)
source: maintainer on doldecomp/sms#329 (2026-10-11): no agent notes at all; project chat: frame numbers in comments waste tokens and go stale

fix: keep it only if it says something the code cannot: a `// fabricated` marker, a Shift-JIS translation, a retail quirk. Comments that restate the code (`// TWaterGun` after a TWaterGun* field) are noise
source: maintainer on doldecomp/sms#329 and project chat 2026-09-17

fix: drop `this->`; read the member directly
source: maintainer cleanup notes, project chat

fix: use <Dir/File.hpp>; the tree includes with angle brackets
source: maintainer cleanup notes, project chat

fix: gotos are banned. A goto-shaped flow is an inline with an early return: find the inline, or leave the function unmatched
source: maintainer, project chat

fix: delete it and leave the frame unmatched. PAD_STACK, volatile locals and trash arrays are banned, labelled or not; AI work matches up to stack frame size
source: maintainer 2026-10-13; PR #130

fix: use JGeometry::TUtil<f32>::sqrt or MsSqrtf; every JSystem math helper is real
source: maintainer, project chat

fix: use ARRAY_COUNT(x) from <macros.h>
source: maintainer review, #329 discussion

message: declares a function extern inside a .cpp
fix: `extern` on a function declaration means it does not belong here. Include the header that declares it, or add the declaration to its proper header
source: maintainer, project chat

fix: use MtxPtr for matrix parameters and pointers, unless the code really points at a whole Mtx array
source: maintainer, project chat

fix: SMS_GetMarioPos() is the spelling he asks for. Check the match: an inlined accessor can cost stack, so keep the raw read only if the accessor measurably breaks the function
source: maintainer, project chat: mPosition.set(SMS_GetMarioPos())

fix: SMSGetMarDirector()->... Same check as mario-pos-raw
source: maintainer, project chat

fix: name it from what it holds, or fold it away; most Ghidra temporaries are loads MWCC deduplicates itself
source: maintainer: few temporaries; name things once every use can be read

message: puts a fabricated inline in a header
fix: keep new fabricated inlines in the .cpp that needs them unless ~10 call sites across files prove it. Shared headers like HitActor.hpp are where a wrong guess spreads
source: maintainer, project chat: fabricate only when sure; one inline that fixes many functions is probably real
